## English

- **DSH 0.2.2 background jobs work over Remote.** 0.2.2 added the `job/list` and `job/follow` streams and the `job/kill` call, but the Host Remote allowlist still ended at the 0.2.0 set. The client received `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`, served `job/list` locally (warning per call), and could not open the `job/follow` stream. All three endpoints are forwarded to the Host again, so the job roster, live output and human kill work through Remote.
- **A 50-message ladder for every history page, opening snapshot included.** 0.5.6 capped every Remote history page at 50 messages; a later build let ordinary sessions ask for 500 and used 120/80 in between, but a 500-message page - and even a 120-message first frame, about 2.9 MB - made every session slow to open, and the client's session list briefly showed untitled rows while that frame crossed. The Host now takes at most 50 messages per page, measures the encoded form, and steps down the same 50/30/20/12/6/3/1 ladder only when it would not fit one secure message. Each session remembers the size that last fit.
- **Files open again after a session changes its working directory.** DSH resolves a `workspaceFiles` path against the session's **header** cwd, so after a mid-run `working-directory/change` a relative link (or a deliverable path built from the old root) missed the file and only that session's documents failed to open. The Host reads the live `workingDirectory` projection, re-roots the path from the header root onto it before dispatch, and falls back to the original path if the re-rooted read misses. No filesystem search is involved.
- **Every Codex Project session appears again, whatever case its directory uses.** The workspace grouping compared a thread's cwd with the project root literally; Codex records the same Windows directory as `C:\Workspace\OpenCOOD` for some threads and `C:\Workspace\opencood` for the project, so 7 of 19 opencood threads were dropped and the client showed 12. The comparison is case-insensitive on Windows again, each session and native thread row reports its cwd under the project root's spelling, and the browser's row list is served from that same catalog instead of Codex's page.
- **Codex threads outside every project get a 默认工作区.** Rows the Codex app lists from other directories are now exposed in one stable default workspace instead of being filtered out; `codex.showUnprojectedSessions` (default on) controls it.
- **Codex history uses the same first-paint ladder as DS.** Opening or older pages start at 50/30/20/12/6/3/1 and are measured against the secure budget; the Host indexes turn ids and event counts without full items and loads full items tail-first (a real 136-turn thread opens from 25 tail turns, ~464 KB), with contiguous seqs and a per-thread window cache. The client reuses its last history page for 60 seconds, so switching back to an already-open Session does not fetch it again. The 200-message clamp and legacy `thread/read` fallback are gone.
- **Codex history diagnostics are opt-in.** The client writes `codex-history-cache-stats.json` only when `DSH_CODEX_HISTORY_STATS=1` is set before the client starts. The file contains cache metadata only, never message text; the history cache itself is always on.
- **Signing in no longer gets stuck on "Signing in…".** The settings poll started a new DeepSeek-to-Server authorization on every call (a duplicated reconcile call made it two per poll), so a card whose exchange had already succeeded was restarted before its flag could clear, and every attempt re-registered the device. At most one exchange runs at a time now.
- **History loads for the official DSH client again.** Its RPC sends positional arguments whose params wrap the request (`{ args: [{ request }] }`), and the page-size ladder rewrote the wrong level, so the Host rejected every page (and the `session/follow` snapshot) as an internal error and all Sessions said "history failed to load". The window is now rewritten inside the innermost request, whichever wrapper arrived.
- **A refused credential no longer loops forever.** The Server refuses a hello with close code 4001 and names the refusal in the close reason. The Host ignored that reason and treated every 4001 as a network failure, so a Host whose token had been invalidated kept presenting it every thirty seconds - one real Host did that for four hours and stayed offline until the process was restarted. Known refusal codes are honoured now; terminal ones stop the loop and let the automatic re-authorization run.
- **A healthy Host can no longer be stuck "offline".** Every Server control frame - the heartbeat included - used to wait behind one serialized queue, and closing the socket waited for that same queue with no deadline. One slow handler therefore starved the heartbeat until the Server marked the device offline, and then blocked the reconnect that would have fixed it; only restarting the process recovered. Heartbeats are answered immediately now, and the close path gives in-flight frames five seconds before reconnecting anyway.
- Everything from **0.5.1** to **0.5.8** ships here too: Codex Session ids back to `codex:<threadId>`, sign-in that follows DSH, Codex off by default, the credential-lock reclaim, dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 gateway compatibility, and the standby/reconnect fixes.

## 中文

- **DSH 0.2.2 的后台任务面板可以通过 Remote 使用。** 0.2.2 新增了 `job/list`、`job/follow` 两个 stream 和 `job/kill` 调用，但 Host 的 Remote 白名单仍停在 0.2.0 的端点集合。客户端把 job 端点转发过去后收到 `METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED`，`job/list` 退回本地并每调用一次刷一条 warning，`job/follow` stream 也打不开。现在三个 job 端点都会转发到 Host gateway，任务列表、实时输出和人工终止都能远程使用。
- **所有历史页（包括首屏）统一钳到 50 条阶梯。** 0.5.6 把所有 Remote 历史页钳在 50 条；后来的版本让普通会话请求 500 条、并用 120/80 做中间档，但 500 条的页——甚至 120 条的首帧（约 2.9 MB）——让每个会话打开都变慢，传输期间客户端会话列表还会短暂显示“未命名”。现在 Host 每页最多取 50 条，量一下编码后的大小，只有装不进一条安全消息时才沿同一条 50/30/20/12/6/3/1 阶梯下调；每个会话记住上次装下的窗口。
- **会话中途切换工作目录后文件也能打开。** DSH 按会话 **header** 的 cwd 解析 `workspaceFiles` 路径，中途 `working-directory/change` 之后，相对链接（或从旧根构建的交付物路径）就找不到文件，只有这个会话的文档打不开。Host 现在读取实时的 `workingDirectory` 投影，在派发前把路径从 header 根重定位到实时目录；如果重定位后的读取未命中，再回退到原始路径。不涉及文件系统搜索。
- **Codex 项目里目录大小写不同的会话也全部显示。** 工作区分组按字面比较 thread 的 cwd 和项目根；Windows 上 Codex 有些会话记成 `C:\Workspace\OpenCOOD`、项目根却是 `C:\Workspace\opencood`，于是 opencood 的 19 个会话里有 7 个被丢掉，客户端只显示 12 个。现在 Windows 上恢复大小写不敏感比较，会话和原生 `thread/list` 行的 cwd 都重定位到项目根的拼写（保留子目录），浏览器的行列表也改为从这份 catalog 返回而不是转发 Codex 的分页。
- **不属于任何项目的 Codex 会话进入“默认工作区”。** Codex App 里来自其它目录的会话不再被过滤掉，而是统一放进一个稳定的默认工作区；`codex.showUnprojectedSessions`（默认开启）控制这个行为。
- **Codex 历史与 DS 使用同一套首屏阶梯。** 打开和旧页都从 50/30/20/12/6/3/1 开始并按安全预算测量；Host 只建 turn 编号和事件数索引（不取 full items），full items 按尾部窗口加载（真实 136-turn 会话首开只取 25 个尾部 turn、约 464 KB），seq 连续、并带每 Thread 的窗口缓存。客户端会复用最近 60 秒内的历史页，切回已打开会话不再重新取。200 条夹取和旧 `thread/read` 回退已删除。
- **Codex 历史诊断文件改为显式开启。** 只有客户端启动前设置 `DSH_CODEX_HISTORY_STATS=1` 才会写 `codex-history-cache-stats.json`；文件只含缓存元数据，不含消息正文；历史缓存本身始终开启。
- **登录不会再卡在“正在登录…”**。设置轮询每次都会重新发起一遍 DeepSeek→Server 授权（重复的 reconcile 调用让它每轮跑两次），已经成功的卡片还没清掉标记就又被重新开始，而且每次都重新注册设备。现在同一时刻只允许一个授权交换。
- **官方 DSH 客户端的历史加载恢复。** 它的 RPC 用位置参数把请求包在 `{ args: [{ request }] }` 里，而分页阶梯改写了外层，Host 于是把每个分页（以及 `session/follow` 的首帧快照）都当成内部错误拒绝，所有会话都显示“历史加载失败”。现在会在最内层的 request 里改写窗口，无论外面是哪一层包装。
- **凭据被拒后不再无限重连。** Server 拒绝 hello 时用 4001 关闭，并把拒绝原因写在 close reason 里。Host 以前忽略这个原因，把所有 4001 都当成网络故障，于是一个 token 已失效的 Host 每 30 秒拿着同一个死 token 重试——真实案例持续了四个小时，直到进程重启才恢复。现在会识别 close reason 里的已知拒绝码：终止类停止重试并让自动重新授权接管。
- **健康的 Host 不会再被卡成“离线”。** 以前所有 Server 控制帧（包括心跳）都在同一个串行队列里，而 socket 关闭时又无期限地等这个队列。只要有一个慢处理器，心跳就会被饿到 Server 判定设备离线，随后连本该恢复的重连也被卡住，只能重启进程才能好。现在心跳立即在队列外应答，关闭路径最多等 5 秒就继续重连。
- **0.5.1**–**0.5.8** 的全部内容同样包含在本版：Codex Session id 恢复为 `codex:<threadId>`、跟随 DSH 的登录、Codex 默认关闭、凭据刷新锁回收、对 dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 的网关兼容，以及待命/重连修复。
